inline_ownership.reason: Existing line-specific negative tests, white-box access, checked dynamic dependency adapters and missing third-party stubs are content-bound, separately from file controls.
inline_ownership.revisit: Review the complete line and suppression whenever its content changes. Remove stale exceptions; keep invalid-input assertions. PublicSuffixList and pip-audit RequirementSource lack supplied typing markers in this pinned environment; no missing-module-source exception is required.

dynamic-json-fixtures.reason: Existing synthetic JSON/schema fixtures use generic nested containers or object-valued runtime dictionaries rather than a complete static shape. Existing diagnostic identities remain blocking against replacement or growth.
dynamic-json-fixtures.revisit: Narrow the accessed value or type the actual fixture shape when editing this test; preserve assertions and malformed/unknown inputs.

fixture-parameters.reason: Legacy fixture and parametrized-test signatures omit parameter annotations; production unknown-parameter checks have no exception.
fixture-parameters.revisit: Annotate the fixture signature with its actual pytest/Hypothesis/runtime contract when editing it; keep intentional invalid inputs explicit.

negative-or-double.reason: Legacy invalid-input cases and structural test doubles intentionally differ from a declared call contract, or use invariant mutable fixture containers. These test-only call identities remain pinned.
negative-or-double.revisit: Prefer an accurate fixture/readonly protocol or an explicitly explained negative-test line when touching the case. Never change the tested runtime input merely to satisfy typing.

private-contract.reason: White-box regression tests deliberately inspect implementation helpers; the formatter facade also forwards its private implementation contract.
private-contract.revisit: Remove the exception if the private access is no longer part of this regression or forwarding contract; new accesses require review.

unknown-containers.reason: Partially known mapping/list members and propagated dynamic adapter results remain at the listed path. These are measured diagnostics, not an assumption that a dependency lacks stubs.
unknown-containers.revisit: When editing this boundary, replace the producing container/adapter with checked object narrowing or an accurate fixture type, then remove the corresponding control and diagnostic identity.
